constraints: Change exactly one numeric constant; leave every other setting untouched.
Do not modify anything under the evaluator directory.
Use only the allowed tools to inspect, edit, and test.
goal: A policy test reports that the HTTP configuration in workspace/app_settings.py violates the deployment policy. Read the file, run the evaluator test, make the minimal edit that clears the violation, and verify with a rerun.
